description: check:guardrails assertion 8 (scripts/grammar-guardrails.mjs): grammar sites that predate the gate. A lookahead or attempt entry is one site, identified by rule, file and const, and `resolved` is a fingerprint of the site and every definition it reaches, with comments and formatting ignored. Other entries match by rule, file and construct. `line` is refreshed by --prune-baselines. `undocumentedRules` lists, by file, the rules with no JSDoc block. A new site is never allowed. A site whose fingerprint moves fails until its `resolved` is updated and a `changed` note says why; the gate prints every note, and CI fails a pull request that adds a site or moves a fingerprint with no new note. A removed site must be removed here.
